## Problem Statement

What problem does this solve? Who experiences it? Why does it matter?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Include user flows, API changes, UI sketches, or data model updates if relevant.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is this the best path?

## Scope & Impact

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **User-facing** | Yes / No |
| **API change** | Yes / No (breaking?) |
| **Schema migration** | Yes / No |
| **New dependencies** | Yes / No (list) |
| **Configuration** | New env vars? |
| **Tests needed** | API / DOM / both |

Links to designs, research, related issues, or prior art.
